title: Binary Tree Longest Consecutive Sequence II
goal: Solve Binary Tree Longest Consecutive Sequence II: Given the root of a binary tree, return the length of the longest consecutive path, where the path may be increasing or decreasing and may travel child -> parent -> child.
strategy: Given the root of a binary tree, return the length of the longest consecutive path, where the path may be increasing or decreasing and may travel child -> parent -> child.
